segments.name: Predictive analytics
segments.description: Provides AI-based predictive analytics, software and services to U.S. government, defense, national security and select commercial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's segment provides predictive analytics capabilities in highly complex, distributed, mission-based operating environments.

revenueModel.text: Government and commercial customers pay the company for custom-designed AI software and services delivered under contracts.

changes.text: In 2025, the company completed the acquisition of Ask Sage, adding a generative AI platform for defense and intelligence customers.
changes.evidence: On December 31st, 2025, BigBear.ai announced that it had completed the acquisition of Ask Sage, a platform-agnostic generative AI solution designed specifically to serve defense and intelligence customers.
